Stockfish.js 19 (single-threaded lite build) by Chess.com, based on Stockfish by the Stockfish developers.
The engine is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3. The full license text is in COPYING.txt.
Source code of the engine and of this build: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js and https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish
Network: nn-61e7af4bb97d by Chris Bao (sscg13), embedded in the wasm file.
Ornate Chess uses these two files unchanged to check generated puzzles in the browser.
